headline: American Express announces global workforce reduction of roughly 3,500 jobs
summary: American Express plans to eliminate about 3,500 positions, representing 5% of its global workforce, following a $336 million pretax restructuring charge.
why: Restructuring charges and workforce reductions signal corporate cost-discipline strategies aimed at protecting operating margins during economic uncertainty.

impacts.name: American Express Co.
impacts.why: Overhead reductions through job cuts typically improve long-term operating efficiency and earnings margins.

why_moved: Pretax restructuring charges and planned headcount reductions reassured investors regarding proactive expense management.
